title: 第2387章 她在哪里第2386章 为何不醒
slug: 皇叔借点功德王妃把符画猛了
lines: 陆昭菱竟然这样完全没有任何异样的，醒不过来。
殷长行和殷云庭都给她检查过，是真的完全没有什么不对，她体温正常，呼吸正常，脸色也正常，看起来就只是睡熟了。
没有半点不对劲。
周时阅已经仔细地回想了十遍昨晚的细节，一丁点都没有放过。
是真的没有发生过什么，完全没有不对的。
青木等人也仔细地回想，阵法外面也没有任何不对劲，没有任何东西接近。
殷长行之前站在阵法外就已经检查过了，阵法没有受到任何攻击，也没有任何东西入侵阵法。
一切都很正常。
周时阅在陆昭菱身边，他也是睡着的，但也不是睡得很熟，他还大概醒了三四次，确认陆昭菱在他怀里好好睡着。
他自己醒来之后也没有异常，甚至，还因为睡了一觉，精神是好的。
而且陆昭菱现在脉象也是正常平稳的。
可她就是不醒。
他们都试过了几次，后来叫她名字的声音可以称得上响亮了，她依然连表情都没动过。
周时阅甚至用了点力道掐了掐她的脸，她也没有知觉。
“这绝对不是睡着的样子。”
周时阅看着她脸颊被自己掐过留下的淡淡的红痕。
要真是睡着了，被他这么掐一下，她至少会皱一下眉，下意识动一下想要避开。
但是她真的是一动不动的。
殷长行和殷云庭也对视了一眼。
他们当然知道，这绝对不是单纯地睡着了。
但到底是怎么回事？
他们竟然查不出来！
千定星和盛三娘子也过来了。
这里动静已经不算小，他们当然不可能不知道，何况盛三娘子本来就想等陆昭菱醒来。
“这到底是怎么回事啊？”
盛三娘子急得不行，甚至想往陆昭菱脖子吹一口阴风。
这能不会将她冻醒？
千定星皱着眉，猜测道：“她会不会是灵魂出窍了？”
灵魂出窍？
殷云庭顿了一下，“大师姐不会的。”
就算是要灵魂出窍，也得因为什么事。
而且她真要灵魂出窍，总得先跟他们说一下吧。
殷长行更是摇了摇头，“阵法在这里，本来就是连鬼气都要防着的，所以灵魂出窍也出不去。”
就算是灵魂出窍，也该有动静。
只要有一点儿动静，他们就会知道。
但是他们一点儿感觉都没有，这本来就不对。
除非有什么人修为比他们都高出那么一大截，出了手。
想到这里，周时阅突然抬眸看向了殷长行。
“师父，你说，有没有可能是，本王岳父？”他缓缓说了这么一句话。
陆昭菱在他怀里，这么一动不动地，他现在看起来很正常，可谁能知道，他已经快疯了。
越是疯，外表越是平静。
因为昨晚一晚，陆小二都是在他怀里的，他好好地这么守着人，把人守出问题了！这种崩溃和自责谁能知道？
content_en:
Lu Zhaoling didn't feel any strange at all and couldn't wake up.
Yin Changxing and Yin Yunting both checked her, and there was nothing wrong with her. Her body temperature was normal, her breathing was normal, and her complexion was normal. She seemed to be asleep.
Nothing is wrong at all.
Zhou Shiyue has carefully recalled the details of last night ten times without missing a single bit.
Nothing really happened, nothing was wrong at all.
Aoki and others also recalled carefully that there was nothing wrong outside the formation, and nothing was approaching.
Yin Changxing had already checked while standing outside the formation before. The formation had not been attacked by any attack, nor had anything invaded the formation.
Everything is normal.
Zhou Shiyue was asleep next to Lu Zhaoling, but not very deeply. He woke up about three or four times to make sure that Lu Zhaoling was sleeping soundly in his arms.
There was nothing abnormal after he woke up. In fact, he was in good spirits because of a good sleep.
Moreover, Lu Zhaoling's pulse condition is now normal and stable.
But she just wouldn't wake up.
They tried several times, and finally the voice calling her name could be called loud, but she still didn't even move her expression.
Zhou Shiyue even pinched her face with some force, but she was unconscious.
"This definitely doesn't look like sleeping."
Zhou Shiyue looked at the faint red marks on her cheeks left by his pinching.
If she was really asleep and pinched by him like this, she would at least frown and subconsciously try to avoid it.
But she was really motionless.
Yin Changxing and Yin Yunting also looked at each other.
Of course they knew that this was definitely not just falling asleep.
But what's going on?
They couldn't find it out!
Qian Dingxing and Lady Sheng San also came over.
There was already quite a movement here, and of course it was impossible for them not to know about it, not to mention that Mrs. Sheng Sanniang originally wanted to wait for Lu Zhaoling to wake up.
"What the hell is going on?"
Madam Sheng Sanniang was so anxious that she even wanted to blow a breath of cold wind on Lu Zhaoling's neck.
Will this freeze her awake?
Qian Dingxing frowned and guessed: "Could her soul have left her body?"
Out-of-body experience?
Yin Yunting paused and said, "Senior Sister can't do that."
Even if the soul wants to leave the body, it must be because of something.
And if she really wanted to have an out-of-body experience, she had to tell them first.
Yin Changxing even shook his head, "The formation is here to guard against even the ghost energy, so the soul can't get out even if it leaves the body."
Even if the soul is out of body, there should be movement.
If there's any movement, they'll know it.
But they don't feel anything at all, and that's not right in the first place.
Unless there is someone whose cultivation level is much higher than them all and takes action.
Thinking of this, Zhou Shiyue suddenly raised his eyes and looked at Yin Changxing.
"Master, tell me, is it possible that he is my father-in-law?" He said slowly.
Lu Zhaoling was in his arms, so motionless. He seemed normal now, but who could have known that he was going crazy.
The crazier he is, the calmer he appears.
Because Lu Xiaoer was in his arms all night last night. He was so protective of people, but something went wrong! Who could know this kind of collapse and self-blame?
title_en: Chapter 2387 Where is she? Chapter 2386 Why doesn’t she wake up?
